Yesterday I received the carrier's written claims note, but I haven't been able to upload it to the claims system yet because it was in its weekly maintenance window. The note approves defense-funded mediation first and settlement authority of exactly $900,000, provided the company follows that sequence. Given our recordkeeping procedure, I want to make sure these operative terms are formally entered into the committee record before we proceed to approval.

This instruction has not yet been added to the claim plan, and it's directly relevant to how we approach both the injunctive relief and public disclosure demands in the complaint.

The check revealed that the proposed panel firm currently represents the lead plaintiff's employer in an unrelated but active matter. This creates a direct conflict, so the company cannot use that panel firm and must appoint independent defense counsel instead. I have not yet issued my written clearance, and I'm formally disclosing this now so the committee can account for it before approving the response package.
